description: This file acts as a module exporting specific types, classes, functions, and constants related to the ACP runtime, plugin system, and Windows spawn utilities. It primarily consolidates exports from various other files to expose API surfaces for the SDK.

methods.name: registerAcpRuntimeBackend
methods.description: Registers a new ACP runtime backend so it can be utilized within the system.

methods.name: unregisterAcpRuntimeBackend
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered ACP runtime backend.

methods.name: applyWindowsSpawnProgramPolicy
methods.description: Applies policy rules to a Windows spawn program.

methods.name: materializeWindowsSpawnProgram
methods.description: Converts a candidate spawn program into a finalized spawn program.

methods.name: resolveWindowsSpawnProgramCandidate
methods.description: Resolves a candidate Windows spawn program into an executable form.

methods.name: listKnownProviderAuthEnvVarNames
methods.description: Lists environment variable names for provider authentication.

methods.name: omitEnvKeysCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Removes specified environment variable keys case-insensitively from a set.
